Our model

Three ways to sell on marketplaces. Only one aligns our interests.

Doing it yourself costs time and expertise. An agency bills you whether you sell or not. We buy your products and only earn when they sell.

Do it yourself

In-house

Hire a fully dedicated person
Train staff in marketplace expertise
Handle compliance alone (VAT, EPR, IOSS)
Take on complaints, logistics and returns
An agency

Marketplace agency

Bills you by the hour, whether you sell or not
Takes a commission on every sale
Gets paid even if your products don't sell
Leaves you to fund the stock and carry the risk
Remains an external provider
VS
Avec

The distribution-partner model

Only makes money by selling your products
Buys your stock: you fund nothing
Takes on the financial risk for you
Handles compliance, logistics, returns and complaints
Becomes a partner aligned with your success
Why us

Why brands trust us with their distribution

Selling across Europe is a maze of rules, taxes and logistics. We've already solved it.

Access to the European market

Sell across Europe without handling the complexity: languages, VAT, cross-border logistics and country-by-country compliance. We open the markets for you.

Our expertise

A trained team dedicated to each marketplace, mastering optimization, ranking. We know what sells, country by country.

Our success depends on yours

No expertise fees, no fixed costs. We're paid only on sales. If your products don't sell, we earn nothing: our interests are fully aligned.

Revenue growth

By showcasing your products in up to 27 countries and to millions of consumers, we multiply your sales and grow your revenue.
